entities.summary: Renato Fasano was a heads of state & government in Naples (1902-08-21, Naples – 1979-08-03) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced national policy and international relations.
